Data structures for parsing Amazon Linux Security Advisory (ALAS) update information from XML feeds, with JSON serialization support.

## Key Components

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `Reference` | Advisory reference metadata (href, ID, title, type) |
| `Package` | Affected RPM package details (name, version, epoch, release, arch) |
| `Updated` | Timestamp for when an advisory was last updated |
| `Issued` | Timestamp for when an advisory was first issued |
| `UpdateInfo` | Full advisory record including severity, CVE IDs, packages, and references |
| `Updates` | Root container holding a list of `UpdateInfo` entries parsed from XML |

## Usage Example

```go
package main

import (
    "encoding/xml"
    "fmt"
    "github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/your/path/amazon"
)

func main() {
    data := []byte(`
        <updates>
            <update>
                <id>ALAS-2024-001</id>
                <title>Important Security Update</title>
                <severity>Important</severity>
                <issued date="2024-01-15"/>
                <updated date="2024-01-16"/>
                <pkglist>
                    <collection>
                        <package name="openssl" version="1.1.1" release="1.amzn2" arch="x86_64"/>
                    </collection>
                </pkglist>
                <references>
                    <reference href="https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2024-0001"
                        id="CVE-2024-0001" type="cve"/>
                </references>
            </update>
        </updates>`)

    var updates amazon.Updates
    if err := xml.Unmarshal(data, &updates); err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }

    for _, info := range updates.UpdateList {
        fmt.Printf("Advisory: %s | Severity: %s\n", info.ID, info.Severity)
        for _, pkg := range info.Packages {
            fmt.Printf("  Package: %s-%s\n", pkg.Name, pkg.Version)
        }
    }
}
```

## Notes

- Structs support both XML (via `encoding/xml`) and JSON (via `encoding/json`) unmarshalling
- `UpdateInfo.CVEIDs` and `UpdateInfo.Repository` are JSON-only fields populated after XML parsing
- `Packages` are parsed from the nested XML path `pkglist > collection > package`
